name: MatchHighlight
purpose: Inline highlight behind the text that matches the search query, in task titles and note previews. Kept as its own widget (A) because a highlight is a separate job from a text label (A's Text excludes search highlights) and its fill token is still open. B folded it into a Text emphasis axis; that axis is dropped here. Fill: accent-500 at 25% light and 30% dark, radius 3px, text inherits.
open: The fill is accent-500 at 25% light and 30% dark. Accent is reserved for primary action and selection, so the match highlight needs its own non-accent search highlight token (B). Decision needed. Placement and count of matches are approximate in the catalogue.
